question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The __humble__ pupil sat on the floor with respect.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**Humble**' means not thinking that you are better or more important than other people; not proud.(विनम्र)

 
 
• **Example **- He came from a **humble**, unprivileged background.
 
 
 
• '**Proud**' means feeling that you are better and more important than other people.(गर्व)
 
 
• **Example **- She was too **proud **to ask for help.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of '**Humble**' is '**Proud**'.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is '**Proud**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences.

 
• **Corrupt **(भ्रष्ट) - Doing or involving illegal or dishonest things in exchange for money.

 
 
• **Example **- The tax inspectors are thoroughly **corrupt**.
 
 
 
• **Capitalist **(पूंजीवादी) - Someone who hopes to profit by investing money or financing business ventures.
 
 
• **Example **- Marxism teaches that modern **capitalist **society is a society of antagonistic classes.
 
 
 
• **Sturdy **(तगड़ा, मज़बूत) - Strong and healthy; that will not break easily.
 
 
• **Example **- This bike is **sturdy **enough to cope with bumpy tracks.
 
 

47:Tab1,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**&
